**Finding submitted — ASSIGN: deviation (Section 10.3, p0063).**

- **What the document says:** Section 10.3 is only a "binding upon successors and assigns" sentence. It is the sole assignment-related provision in the Agreement (no change-of-control language anywhere; Section 4.1 termination is mutual non-renewal on 90 days' notice, which belongs to RENEWAL and was not flagged here).
- **Why it fails fallback:** no express successor-assignment right for either party, no written-notice mechanic, no consent requirement and no reasonableness standard — all four fallback elements are unmet, and HDI is left free to assign the hosting engagement (and its licensed use of our "Deerskin" brand) to a competitor.
- **Cure:** one short inserted paragraph after Section 10.3 carrying all six preferred elements — our free assignment to an affiliate or transaction successor, no HDI termination right on our change of control, HDI assignment only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a competitor. Existing text is preserved verbatim.
